company.value: Linear is a remote-first software company building a product-development system for teams and agents. Its current positioning spans customer discovery, planning, and execution, with AI and agent capabilities integrated into product workflows.

funding.value: Linear announced an $82M Series C at a $1.25B valuation on June 10, 2025. Accel led, with continued support from Sequoia and 01A, among others.

hiring_signals.value: Linear is actively hiring Account Executives across Enterprise, Growth, and Startups segments in North America. Its Startup AE posting says it is layering a product-led sales motion onto its self-serve business to reach more and larger companies.

The careers page also lists Customer Success, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, and Demand Generation roles—evidence of investment across the GTM and post-sale motion.

likely_use_case.value: Likely evaluating an account-research and AE-enablement workflow that gives a growing, segmented sales team fast account context before inbound-trial/evaluation conversations. This aligns with Linear’s move from self-serve toward product-led sales and its AEs’ responsibility to guide prospects through trials and build stakeholder relationships.
